title: Prism Clinical Rubric
description: Rubric document governing how a clinical (HealthBench Hard) case is scored. Referenced by case.rubric_ref when case.rail == 'clinical'.

rubric_id.description: Stable identifier for this rubric document.

axes.description: Subset of the five HealthBench rubric axes this document scores.

id.description: Criterion identifier unique within this rubric.

weight.description: Criterion weight; sign indicates reward (positive) or penalty (negative).

criteria.description: Weighted list of rubric criteria applied by the grader.

notes.description: Optional free-form provenance or authoring notes.
